messages:
neel: quick design check on the compact in-product docs panel on Routes. found 4 small things we should fix together before the rollout.
anya: list 'em pls, keep short.
neel: 1) Terms drift: UI uses 'variant' in the selector, docs currently use 'model variant' and sometimes just 'variant' in examples. fine but support sees 'flavor' in legacy snippets. propose canonical 'model variant' everywhere (clearer for new users).
frank: ok for 'model variant' if we're explicit. will add a tiny alias note in the docs for backward-compat.
neel: 2) Anchors: the "Examples" quick link opens the page top. users expect the examples block. add stable anchors for the common sections and make the small target icon open the doc at that anchor. fallback to top if missing.
a11y: accessibility: target icon must be keyboard-focusable and include aria-label like "Open docs: routing examples". landing anchor should have a visually-hidden summary for SRs.
neel: 3) CTA copy: inline link says "Read", main button says "Docs". change to action-first: inline -> "See routing examples" when relevant, button -> "Open docs". on mobile collapse extras into one overflow action.
frank: will implement context-aware inline copy + mobile overflow.
neel: 4) Focus/escape: panel opens but focus sometimes stays on trigger in Safari; ESC isn't consistent in Firefox. add focus trap, move focus to panel heading on open, return focus on close, and ensure ESC closes across browsers. also announce with aria-live "Help panel opened: Routing".
a11y: add those ARIA hooks and i'll run a short checklist (NVDA + VoiceOver) after the PR.
docs-bot: docs-bot: opened PR #804 to add anchors, glossary snippet, and CTA copy updates: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/804
neel: tiny extra: add a 3-term mini-glossary at the panel footer (collapsed disclosure) for KV cache / prefetch / dedicated capacity. keep collapsed on mobile.
frank: noted. i'll include the glossary as a disclosure with aria-expanded.
anya: timeline: frank to post a short spec + copy before EOD; a11y to run checklist post-PR; neel will triage into next sprint.
neel: thanks all, ping this thread when PR#804 is review-ready. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Product design review for compact in-product docs panel on Routes: canonicalize 'model variant' term (avoid 'flavor'), add stable section anchors and make target icon keyboard-focusable with aria-label and SR summary at landing, change CTAs to action-first wording and collapse extras into mobile overflow, ensure consistent focus trap + ESC behavior and aria-live announcement, and add a collapsed 3-term glossary. docs-bot links PR #804.
